idioms.meaning_vi: thay đổi cuộc sống sang một chương mới bằng cách trở thành một người tốt hơn

idioms.meaning_vi: chỉ một lượng nhỏ so với tổng số lượng cần (hạt muối bỏ biển)
idioms.example: A thousand dollars is just a drop in the ocean compared to the millions required for hospital renovation.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Their small donation is wonderful, but it is just a drop in the _____ compared to the total debt.

idioms.meaning_en: have no profit or loss at the end of a business activity
idioms.meaning_vi: không có doanh thu hay thua lỗ sau một thời gian của một tổ chức/doanh nghiệp (hòa vốn)
idioms.example: In its first year of operation, the café managed to break even despite tough competition.
idioms.cloze_sentence: We hope to sell at least 500 tickets just to break _____ on the venue rental costs.

idioms.meaning_en: fail to reach an amount or standard that was expected or hoped for, causing disappointment
idioms.meaning_vi: không thể đạt được tiêu chuẩn/ số lượng được mong đợi, gây ra sự thất vọng
idioms.example: The quarterly sales figures fell short of our initial targets.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The sequel movie fell _____ of the fans' high expectations.

idioms.meaning_en: equal, or into two equal parts
idioms.meaning_vi: hai phần bằng nhau/chia đôi (năm mươi năm mươi)
idioms.example: They agreed to split the profits fifty-fifty between both business partners.
idioms.cloze_sentence: There is a _____ chance of rain this afternoon.

idioms.meaning_en: share the cost of sth with sb so that you each pay 50%
idioms.meaning_vi: chia tiền cần thanh toán ra một nửa để cả hai cùng trả
idioms.example: The gourmet pizza was huge, so my friend and I decided to go halves on it.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Do you want to go _____ on a taxi to the airport?

idioms.idiom: it's as broad as it's long
idioms.clean_phrase: as broad as it is long
idioms.meaning_en: used for saying that you cannot choose between two things or actions because they are equal
idioms.meaning_vi: sử dụng để nói rằng bản thân không thể lựa chọn 1 trong 2 điều gì đó vì chúng bằng nhau (đằng nào cũng thế, kẻ tám lạng người nửa cân)
idioms.example: Whether we drive through the highway toll or take the bypass, it's as broad as it's long.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Taking the train or the express bus costs the same; it's as _____ as it's long.

idioms.meaning_en: try to be as rich, successful, etc as your neighbors or friends
idioms.meaning_vi: cố gắng đua theo để trở nên giàu có và thành công,... như những người bạn hay những người xung quanh (chạy theo trào lưu, đua đòi)
idioms.example: They bought a luxury sports car they couldn't afford just to keep up with the Joneses.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Stop trying to keep up with the _____ and live within your own financial means.

idioms.meaning_en: very small, because you were very young
idioms.meaning_vi: rất nhỏ con (do nhỏ tuổi) hoặc rất trẻ
idioms.example: I haven't seen Emily since she was knee-high to a grasshopper; now she is graduating college!
idioms.cloze_sentence: I used to fish by this river when I was knee-high to a _____.

idioms.meaning_en: obtain money, especially by acting dishonestly
idioms.meaning_vi: thu/nhận tiền một cách bất hợp pháp (đút lót, tham nhũng, bỏ túi riêng)
idioms.example: Corrupt city officials were accused of lining their pockets with public infrastructure funds.
idioms.cloze_sentence: He abused his government position to line his _____ with illegal bribes.

idioms.meaning_en: including every part of a particular thing, situation, place, etc
idioms.meaning_vi: tất cả mọi thứ của một vật gì đó (toàn bộ, tất tần tật)
idioms.example: The family sold their antique estate lock, stock and barrel before moving abroad.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The investor bought the entire software company _____, stock and barrel.

idioms.idiom: six of one (and) half a dozen of the other
idioms.clean_phrase: six of one and half a dozen of the other
idioms.meaning_en: used for saying that two things are equally good or bad
idioms.meaning_vi: sử dụng để nói rằng cả hai điều đều có 2 mặt tốt và xấu gần như tương tự nhau (như nhau cả thôi)
idioms.example: Whether we take the morning flight or the afternoon train is six of one and half a dozen of the other.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Buying online or at the boutique is six of one and half a _____ of the other.

idioms.meaning_en: large sum/amount of money
idioms.meaning_vi: một khoảng lớn (số tiền kha khá, món tiền lớn)
idioms.example: Selling his early tech stock earned him a very tidy sum.
idioms.cloze_sentence: She inherited a _____ sum of money from her late aunt's estate.

idioms.meaning_en: if you refer swh as 'home from home', you mean that this is the place that you feel just as comfortable as your own house
idioms.meaning_vi: cảm giác thoải mái như ở nhà
idioms.example: The quaint bed-and-breakfast in the countryside was a real home from home.
idioms.cloze_sentence: With its welcoming staff and cozy fireplace, the inn felt like a home from _____.

idioms.meaning_en: sth such as an ugly building that spoils a pleasant view
idioms.meaning_vi: một thứ gì đó xấu xí làm ảnh hưởng một khung cảnh đẹp (vết nhơ cảnh quan)
idioms.example: That derelict concrete warehouse is a terrible blot on the coastal landscape.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The towering rusty chimney was considered an eyesore and a blot on the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: an area around the city where many people who work in the city live
idioms.meaning_vi: ở phía rìa thành phố nơi mà có nhiều người làm việc ở thành phố sống ở đó (vành đai đi làm ngoại ô)
idioms.example: Housing prices in London's commuter belt have risen sharply over the past decade.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Many young professionals choose to reside in the suburban _____ belt to avoid inner-city rents.

idioms.meaning_en: city or urban area with high-density modern buildings that feels harsh, ugly, or devoid of nature
idioms.meaning_vi: những khu vực (dãy nhà cao tầng) ngột ngạt trong thành phố và thiếu đi tính thiên nhiên của chúng (rừng bê tông)
idioms.example: After living in the concrete jungle of Manhattan for five years, he craved fresh mountain air.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Urban planners are adding rooftop gardens to make the concrete _____ greener.

idioms.meaning_en: used as an expression of one's pleasure or relief at being in or returning to one's own home
idioms.meaning_vi: sử dụng để bày tỏ sự giải tỏa hoặc vui sướng khi về đến nhà
idioms.example: After a grueling 14-hour flight and customs delays, we stepped inside and sighed: 'Home sweet home!'
idioms.cloze_sentence: Nothing beats resting on your own sofa after a long expedition: home _____ home!

idioms.meaning_en: a long way from a town or city in an isolated rural area
idioms.meaning_vi: cách xa thành thị (nơi hẻo lánh, miền quê xa xôi)
idioms.example: They bought a rustic farm out in the sticks with no cellular reception.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Living out in the _____ means you have to drive twenty miles to buy groceries.

idioms.meaning_en: act and do things just as normally and comfortably as what you do at home
idioms.meaning_vi: hành xử tự nhiên như đang ở nhà
idioms.example: Please sit down, grab a drink, and make yourself at home!
idioms.cloze_sentence: Help yourself to tea and biscuits, and make _____ at home.

idioms.meaning_en: without a home; homeless
idioms.meaning_vi: không có nhà ở (vô gia cư, sống lang thang ngoài đường)
idioms.example: The winter charity drive provided warm blankets and soup for people living on the streets.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Rising rent costs have forced dozens of low-income families onto the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: enjoying yourself by going to places of entertainment in a town or city (night out)
idioms.meaning_vi: tận hưởng khi đi chơi phố (đi quẩy, đi chơi đêm)
idioms.example: To celebrate her promotion, they went for dinner and cocktails on the town.
idioms.cloze_sentence: We dressed up in our finest evening wear for a fabulous night on the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: an urban entity developed as a separate metropolitan area near to, and largely dependent on a larger central city
idioms.meaning_vi: là đô thị nằm trong một vùng đô thị nào đó và chịu ảnh hưởng trực tiếp bởi thành phố trung tâm (đô thị vệ tinh)
idioms.example: Several satellite towns have emerged around the capital to alleviate urban congestion.
idioms.cloze_sentence: High-speed rail links the capital with surrounding _____ cities.

idioms.meaning_en: waste time feeling upset about sth bad that has happened and cannot be changed
idioms.meaning_vi: tiếc rẻ con gà quạ tha, tốn thời gian tiếc rẻ thứ gì đó đã mất trong quá khứ và không thể lấy lại được
idioms.example: You didn't pass the driving test this time, but it's no use crying over spilt milk; practice more and retake it!
idioms.cloze_sentence: The vase is broken and cannot be glued; there is no point crying over spilt _____.

idioms.meaning_en: suddenly become extremely angry without a good reason
idioms.meaning_vi: đột ngột giận dữ mà không có lý do (nổi trận lôi đình, mất bình tĩnh)
idioms.example: He tends to fly off the handle whenever his computer freezes during a video conference.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Take a deep breath and calm down; there's no reason to fly off the _____.

idioms.idiom: give sb a taste/dose of their own medicine
idioms.clean_phrase: give someone a taste of their own medicine
idioms.meaning_en: treat sb in the same bad way they treat other people
idioms.meaning_vi: làm ai đó có cảm giác khó chịu như cách họ làm với bạn (gậy ông đập lưng ông)
idioms.example: He constantly mocked others, so his classmates gave him a dose of his own medicine.
idioms.cloze_sentence: She arrived late intentionally to give her tardy boyfriend a taste of his own _____.

idioms.meaning_en: decide not to do or attend sth that you usually do
idioms.meaning_vi: quyết định không làm chuyện gì (công việc nào đó mà bạn làm thường xuyên) (bỏ qua, không tham gia)
idioms.example: I'm nursing a headache tonight, so I think I'll give the party a miss.
idioms.cloze_sentence: I'm feeling under the weather, so I'll give yoga class a _____ this evening.

idioms.meaning_en: accept a difficult situation without complaining or showing how you feel
idioms.meaning_vi: mỉm cười chịu đựng, chấp nhận số phận (ngậm đắng nuốt cay)
idioms.example: We had to hike in the torrential rain, so we just had to grin and bear it.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The dental procedure was uncomfortable, but he decided to grin and _____ it.

idioms.meaning_en: remain serious and not laugh despite finding sth funny
idioms.meaning_vi: kiềm chế để giữ bộ mặt bình thản, nghiêm túc (nhịn cười)
idioms.example: It was impossible to keep a straight face when the magician's rabbit escaped into the audience.
idioms.cloze_sentence: During the solemn ceremony, Jack struggled to keep a _____ face when his phone chirped.

idioms.meaning_en: used for telling sb not to get angry or upset; calm down
idioms.meaning_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó bình tĩnh, không tức giận (hạ hỏa)
idioms.example: Keep your hair on! I'll finish loading the dishwasher in just two minutes.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Keep your _____ on! We're not going to miss the train.

idioms.meaning_en: be very annoyed because you have made a mistake, missed an opportunity, etc
idioms.meaning_vi: bạn cảm thấy khó chịu, ấm ức vì đã làm điều gì ngu ngốc, hay bỏ lỡ một cơ hội nào đó (tự trách bản thân)
idioms.example: I kicked myself when I realized I left the flight tickets on the dining table.
idioms.cloze_sentence: You will kick _____ later if you pass up this once-in-a-lifetime scholarship opportunity.

idioms.meaning_en: shout or do sth energetic that allows you to get rid of anger or stress
idioms.meaning_vi: xả hơi, làm gì đó để hết bực dọc, khó chịu
idioms.example: After a stressful week of exams, the students played soccer to let off steam.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Going for a vigorous jog helps him let off _____ after tense client meetings.

idioms.meaning_en: leave a person or situation alone if they might cause you trouble; avoid stirring up old disputes
idioms.meaning_vi: chuyện đã qua hãy để cho nó qua (đừng khơi lại chuyện cũ rắc rối)
idioms.example: They resolved that argument months ago, so let sleeping dogs lie.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Don't bring up the past financial dispute again; let sleeping dogs _____.

idioms.idiom: never/don't look a gift horse in the mouth
idioms.clean_phrase: don't look a gift horse in the mouth
idioms.meaning_en: if you are given sth good, you should not complain about it or try to find things that are wrong with it
idioms.meaning_vi: đừng săm soi quà tặng của người khác dành cho mình (được voi đòi tiên, chê quà)
idioms.example: The free laptop might be an older model, but never look a gift horse in the mouth!
idioms.cloze_sentence: He gave you free concert passes; don't look a gift _____ in the mouth.

idioms.meaning_en: angry and complaining vigorously about sth
idioms.meaning_vi: giận dữ, tức giận và phàn nàn về chuyện gì (kịch liệt phản đối)
idioms.example: Local residents were up in arms about the proposed highway through the nature reserve.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Parents were up in _____ about the unexpected hike in tuition fees.

idioms.idiom: bury/have your head in the sand
idioms.clean_phrase: bury one's head in the sand
idioms.meaning_en: to refuse to think about unpleasant facts, although they will have an influence on your situation
idioms.meaning_vi: từ chối nghĩ về điều gì đó (phần lớn là sự thật, nghĩa vụ, nguy hiểm tiềm tàng) và vờ như chúng không hiện hữu (trốn tránh thực tế / đà điểu giấu đầu vào cát)
idioms.example: Ignoring climate change is just burying your head in the sand.
idioms.cloze_sentence: You cannot solve debt problems by burying your head in the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: if you have the upper hand, you have more power than anyone else and so have control
idioms.meaning_vi: có quyền lực lớn hơn cả (chiếm thế thượng phong, nắm quyền kiểm soát)
idioms.example: After intense contract negotiations, the workers' union gained the upper hand.
idioms.cloze_sentence: With superior strategic positioning, their army took the _____ hand in battle.

idioms.meaning_en: get or do what one wants despite opposition
idioms.meaning_vi: làm việc gì đó mà bản thân hoặc ai đó muốn bất chấp sự phản đối (làm theo ý mình)
idioms.example: He threw a childish tantrum until he finally got his own way.
idioms.cloze_sentence: She is stubborn and always insists on getting her own _____.

idioms.meaning_en: said to mean that people should accept the way other people live and behave, especially if they do things differently
idioms.meaning_vi: sử dụng để khuyên người khác nên chấp nhận cách sống và hành xử khác biệt của mỗi người (dĩ hòa vi quý, sống và để người khác sống)
idioms.example: I might not agree with his eccentric hobbies, but my philosophy is live and let live.
idioms.cloze_sentence: In a diverse cosmopolitan society, we must learn to live and let _____.

idioms.meaning_en: to be in control of an organization or situation secretly / use confidential influence to gain an advantage
idioms.meaning_vi: bí mật nắm giữ, điều khiển một tổ chức, vụ việc nào đó (giật dây, dùng quan hệ ngầm)
idioms.example: His uncle pulled a few strings at the embassy to expedite his visa application.
idioms.cloze_sentence: She managed to secure an audition by having an industry friend pull _____.

idioms.meaning_en: official rules and processes that seem unnecessary and cause delays
idioms.meaning_vi: quy định, quy tắc, thủ tục không cần thiết và gây ra sự chậm trễ (nạn quan liêu, thủ tục rườm rà)
idioms.example: Starting a small business was hindered by endless government red tape.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The humanitarian aid was delayed for weeks by bureaucratic _____ tape.

idioms.idiom: take the law into sb's own hands
idioms.clean_phrase: take the law into one's own hands
idioms.meaning_en: to try to punish sb for breaking a law even though one does not have the legal right to do that
idioms.meaning_vi: cố gắng để trừng trị ai đó bằng chính bản thân vì biết rằng pháp luật sẽ không trừng trị thích đáng (tự xử, tự hành quyết ngoài vòng pháp luật)
idioms.example: Vigilante citizens took the law into their own hands and captured the notorious burglar.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Citizens should call the police rather than taking the law into their own _____.

idioms.meaning_en: important people who have the authority over others; establishment in power
idioms.meaning_vi: những người quan trọng và có tầm ảnh hưởng lên người khác (giới cầm quyền, người có thẩm quyền)
idioms.example: The proposal was vetoed by the powers that be in the central administration.
idioms.cloze_sentence: We are awaiting final budget approval from the powers that _____.

idioms.meaning_en: to punish sb as severely as possible under the law
idioms.meaning_vi: trừng trị ai đó một cách khắt khe nhất có thể (xử phạt kịch khung)
idioms.example: The judge decided to throw the book at the repeat offender, sentencing him to maximum prison time.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The court decided to throw the _____ at the corporate fraudsters.

idioms.meaning_en: to be under one's complete control and influence
idioms.meaning_vi: dưới sự kiểm soát và ảnh hưởng hoàn toàn của ai đó (bị đè đầu cưỡi cổ, dưới quyền)
idioms.example: He has no freedom in the company; he is completely under his manager's thumb.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The assistant was terrified of speaking out because she was under the director's _____.

idioms.meaning_en: a person or thing that one is extremely pleased and delighted to see
idioms.meaning_vi: một người hoặc khung cảnh tuyệt đẹp (cảnh tượng làm dịu mắt, vui mừng khi gặp lại)
idioms.example: After three months lost in the wilderness, the rescue helicopter was a sight for sore eyes.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Seeing your warm smile after this dreadful week is a sight for _____ eyes.

idioms.meaning_en: your weakness or vulnerable point
idioms.meaning_vi: điểm yếu, khuyết điểm (gót chân Asin)
idioms.example: Spelling has always been his Achilles' heel in English competitive examinations.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Poor defensive coordination proved to be the team's Achilles' _____.

idioms.meaning_en: escalate / worsen a conflict or tense situation
idioms.meaning_vi: gây căng thẳng hơn một sự việc nào đó/ tạo ra sự kích động để một sự xung đột nào đó xảy ra (thêm dầu vào lửa)
idioms.example: Publishing the controversial editorial only added fuel to the fire.
idioms.cloze_sentence: His sarcastic remarks during the board dispute only added fuel to the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: ill/ worse than the usual or expected standard
idioms.meaning_vi: bị bệnh/ dưới tiêu chuẩn trung bình được mong đợi
idioms.example: I felt a bit below par yesterday, so I rested in bed with hot ginger tea.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The star player's performance was noticeably below _____ due to a slight fever.

idioms.meaning_en: extremely clean or clear/ if a place is clean as a whistle, it has no incriminating evidence when the police come in
idioms.meaning_vi: chỉ một hiện trường 'sạch sẽ', không có bất cứ chứng cứ phạm tội nào (sạch bóng, không tì vết)
idioms.example: The forensic detectives inspected the suspect's apartment, but it was clean as a whistle.
idioms.cloze_sentence: After scrubbing all morning, the kitchen counters were as clean as a _____.

idioms.meaning_en: set a limit on what one is willing to do or accept, beyond which one will not go
idioms.meaning_vi: đặt ra giới hạn khi ai đó đang làm gì (vạch ra ranh giới)
idioms.example: I don't mind working overtime occasionally, but I draw the line at working on Sundays.
idioms.cloze_sentence: I enjoy playing practical jokes, but I draw the _____ at causing physical harm.

idioms.meaning_en: the best or most modern example of sth (cutting-edge / pinnacle)
idioms.meaning_vi: là thứ tốt nhất và hiện đại nhất của một mảng/điều gì đó (đỉnh cao mới nhất, chuẩn mực tối tân)
idioms.example: This new hybrid hypercar is the last word in automotive safety and luxury.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Their newly unveiled flagship smartphone is the last _____ in mobile photography.

idioms.meaning_en: extremely good, wonderful, or extraordinary
idioms.meaning_vi: cực kì tốt (tuyệt vời, không chê vào đâu được)
idioms.example: The chef's signature truffle pasta was simply out of this world!
idioms.cloze_sentence: The visual effects in that sci-fi blockbuster were out of this _____.

idioms.meaning_en: too extreme and not suitable, or demanding too much attention or effort, especially in an uncontrolled way
idioms.meaning_vi: không phù hợp, đòi hỏi quá nhiều sự chú ý hoặc công sức (quá trớn, quá đà, làm quá)
idioms.example: Her glittering costume was a bit over the top for a casual garden party.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The decorations for a simple birthday celebration were completely over the _____.

idioms.meaning_en: to have the most important position in a group or display
idioms.meaning_vi: có vị trí và tầm ảnh hưởng quan trọng nhất trong một nhóm hoặc tổ chức (chiếm vị trí trang trọng nhất)
idioms.example: The championship trophy took pride of place in the school's central showcase.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Grandfather's vintage oil portrait takes _____ of place above the fireplace.

idioms.meaning_en: to be the most remarkable or popular in an event or situation
idioms.meaning_vi: trở thành thứ nổi bật nhất trong một vụ việc hoặc sự kiện (chiếm trọn spotlight)
idioms.example: The five-year-old violin prodigy completely stole the show with his heartfelt solo.
idioms.cloze_sentence: The hilarious supporting actor stole the _____ from the lead superstar.

idioms.meaning_en: to be slightly better than sb or sth else
idioms.meaning_vi: tốt hơn một chút so với thứ gì/ ai đó (có lợi thế hơn một chút)
idioms.example: With her fluency in three foreign languages, she has the edge over the other job applicants.
idioms.cloze_sentence: Their product has the _____ over competitors thanks to its superior battery life.
